metric: Acceptance gate 1 of REGISTRATION_listen_distributional.md (as AMENDED): the fold arm of controls/family_cave_diagnose_arms.py must reproduce every PRE-EXISTING field of the shipped instrument's committed artifacts, item for item, with the pre-existing keys in the shipped order. Whole-file byte identity is impossible by construction because the registration also mandates additive `arm`/`stamp`/plant-target fields.
decision_rule: FOLD_IDENTICAL per cell iff zero pre-existing fields differ on any of the 82 items. Gate PASS iff every cell is FOLD_IDENTICAL. On FAIL the listen numbers from the same run are NOT usable - a listen number computed by drifted code measures nothing.
